column3: One motion module (web/src/styles/motion.css) implements design system §7, replacing the scattered utilities in app.css and shell/overlay.css and the global reduce-motion rule that cut every animation and transition to 1ms; keyboard-started actions are detected by a root data-input attribute; exits use their own `to` keyframes; right sheet exit is a new token --dur-exit-sheet 180ms; the right pane drawer slides from the right (it used the left drawer keyframes); corner pulse is an opacity breathe at --loop-needs instead of a box-shadow ring; fan-out rows rise 8px like list arrival; Skullet uses its pulse (1 to .45) for the skeleton; grow-in-place animates Ark's measured --height rather than grid-rows; the palette never animates; no toasts exist so none were built
column4: §7 asks for opacity and colour to survive reduce motion and for loops to hold a still frame, which the 1ms rule broke; a CSS animation-direction reverse also reverses the easing into an ease-in; Ark collapsible drives presence and its hidden attribute from animationend on its content, so --height is the Ark-native path; ingle-motion.css is not in the handoff yet so ingle-tokens.css is the source; animation-duration 0s instead of animation none under key input stops an animation restarting when the pointer moves
column5: web typecheck and build; built CSS checked for the hover variant and every utility; headless Chromium check of computed animations under no-preference, reduce and key input
